title: Unit Event — Perspective for Smile — Episode4 What Acting Means

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has finished training with Shunmeiza, and is set to study stage combat with the Mikazukigumi troupe. How will Emu and the others fare on this new, intensely physical stage?!

rows.Line: Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean you're going to play Ushiwakamaru for us?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah, the scene at Gojo Bridge while we're at it. Mind lending me a hand, Tenma...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes, of course...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I need to see what it is that's missing from my acting...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I have to learn what I can to solve this problem...!)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Alright, we'll start from your line partway through about collecting swords...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “One last sword to complete my collection of a thousand! Tonight, my vow comes to fruition...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Drop your katana and leave this place!
Only then shall I spare your life!”
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I don't understand...
All he's doing is walking, but he's giving off such a different impression compared to Emu.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He becomes much more like Ushiwakamaru just by walking like that...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But why...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This must be because...)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
“Oh, have you no manners?
Put away that dreadful thing and look up to the sky.”

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: “See how beautiful the moon is tonight?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Wh-What nonsense do you speak?!
If you refuse to surrender, then it is my naginata you shall face...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: “Hey, now.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(He's dodging so gracefully...!
It's like he's dancing...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (He looks like he's having a lot of fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's as if he's able to channel his character's feelings directly. He is Ushiwakamaru. He can't contain his excitement as he dances on top of that bridge under a moonlit sky.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
That should do it.
I think I've shown you all enough.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, any thoughts?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I thought that was really amazing!
I could tell exactly what Ushiwakamaru was feeling!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
That's great to hear!
I'm glad I was able to do him justice!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Imagine if I slipped up and put on a poor performance in front of all of you! That would've been beyond embarrassing! Hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But do you understand what I meant by your performance being “bland” just now...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I-I'm really sorry...!
I know what I saw was amazing, but I don't know the reason why...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
I see...
However, Kamishiro, I have a feeling that you noticed something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought what Emu showed us a second ago was a nice representation of Ushiwakamaru's free-spirited and whimsical nature.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which tells me that Emu had a fairly good idea of how she wanted to play him. However...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That may not have been reflected in the physical aspects of her portrayal. Something does appear to be missing there...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The physical aspects...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean I'm not really moving like he should? But how specifically...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm not talking about individual actions...
There's something fundamentally different about the way Mr. Kijima physically portrays characters compared to the way we do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: For example, watch...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: This is just a wooden sword, but any normal person would flinch if they were to have a weapon pointed at them. That being said, how would Ushiwakamaru react?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? He'd...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm... It wouldn't bother him at all...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Exactly. Ushiwakamaru is no ordinary person. On top of having nerves of steel, he's a naturally gifted martial artist.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Which probably means he'd be able to keep his cool even if someone were to stick a weapon in his face.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He'd keep his cool...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that must be it...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What must be it, Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I sensed a bottomless supply of confidence coming from his Ushiwakamaru...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He seemed completely at ease the entire time... That's what I saw!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I felt it directly working face to face with him.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No matter how many times I swung my naginata to attack him, he didn't flinch once.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Despite having a naginata flying towards his face, he didn't even raise an eyebrow...!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! Pretty amazing, right?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that is amazing... But how are we supposed to copy you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The truth is, when Tsukasa pointed his naginata at me, I flinched and hesitated a lot!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Of course, I don't expect any of you to be able to succeed right off the bat. But we are actors, after all...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You'll just have to learn how.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Ushiwakamaru wouldn't be bothered by someone thrusting a naginata at him, so he doesn't react fearfully...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I never would've thought to play him that way. I mean, who wouldn't flinch when they saw a person swinging a wooden sword at them...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (If I can figure out how to do that, then I'll be able to portray Ushiwakamaru just as beautifully...!)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Of course, some actors can play these types of characters without having to think about it. The ones who can really dive into their roles.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: They can move their fingers, blink and do all the little things like it's nothing. They're able to become their characters.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But most people can't do that...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Which is why training is so important.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Training...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah. Getting a good grasp of your characters isn't enough. You'll all need to keep training until you're able to perfectly present what you have in mind for them.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: In other words, you need to incorporate every muscle you have into your acting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Into our acting...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'll do my best.
I'm going to train to use every muscle in my body, so that I can perfectly play the Ushiwakamaru I've imagined!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And in one month's time...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I promise to knock your socks off with my performance, Mr. Kijima!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Great, I'll be looking forward to that...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Now, I'd like to present you all with a special gift...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A special gift...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: A special workout regimen that will teach you how to master using even the smallest muscles in your body, as I just mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I call it the “Kijima Special”!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: If you'd like, I can start teaching you all right now. I know you're tired after just finishing practice, but how about it...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, please teach me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'd like to learn as well!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
M-Me too...
I promise not to fall behind...!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Alright, perfect!
In that case, let's go...!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
The first part of the Kijima Special involves...
Sprinting at full speed towards the sun!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Tsukasa, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Okay!
